title: Introspective Quant Auditbench with Contextual Golden Anchors
creator: Miguel Ortega
description:
Objective: Build an automated 'auditbench' that validates FP8/INT8 quantized model variants against contextual golden anchors (cohort-specific golden prompt sets), driving calibration re-runs and rollout gating. This ticket covers the design and first implementation for a reproducible pipeline that performs differential scoring, sample-weighted metrics, cohort drift detection, and automated pass/fail gates integrated with the rollout service.

Scope:
- Define and curate contextual golden anchors per workload cohort (chat, summarization, code, search relevance).
- Implement differential scoring that compares quantized variant outputs to float32 baseline using a blend of semantic similarity (embedding-based), token-level edit distance, and task-specific metrics (ROUGE/BLEU/Exact Match where applicable).
- Add sample weighting and cohort-aware aggregation to avoid noisy microbenchmarks dominating decisions.
- Integrate calibration workflow: trigger per-layer scale/zero-point re-calibration and re-run auditbench automatically when a gate fails.
- Wire pass/fail gates into the rollout controller: automatic canary halt + create rollback PR when delta exceeds threshold.
- Provide observability: dashboard with per-prompt breakdown, anchor-drift chart over time, latency/cost tradeoff heatmaps, and an explainability probe showing which tokens contributed most to divergence.

Design notes / trade-offs:
- We will avoid a single global threshold. Instead we compute cohort-specific thresholds derived from historical baseline variance and business-sensitive guardrails (e.g., authentication flows have stricter limits).
- Semantic similarity will use Redwood embeddings + calibrated cosine thresholds; we will also compute confidence intervals via bootstrap sampling to surface statistical significance.
- To keep CI runtime reasonable, the auditbench will run a two-stage evaluation: quick smoke layer (100 goldens) followed by full validation (2k goldens) for any candidate that passes smoke but is close to threshold.
- We prioritize deterministic evaluation: seed RNGs, snapshot model weights/kernels, and capture runtime config (batch size, kernel selection, sequence length).

Output artifacts from this ticket:
- Auditbench implementation integrated into the calibration pipeline (orchestrator job + runner).
- New metrics exported to metrics service: delta_semantic, delta_token_edit, task_specific_delta, risk_score, cohort_threshold, drift_index.
- Dashboard template and alerting playbook for SRE/Platform.

Non-goals for this iteration:
- Full auto-tuning of quantization policy (this will be a follow-up).
- User-facing UI for golden curation (we'll provide CSV/Confluence-managed anchors initially).
acceptance_criteria: Auditbench runs end-to-end for FP8 and INT8 variants against float32 baseline and produces reproducible metrics
Cohort-specific golden anchors evaluate and produce cohort_threshold values derived from baseline variance
If risk_score > cohort_threshold, calibration workflow is automatically triggered and a failure event is emitted to the rollout controller
Dashboard shows per-prompt diffs, latency and cost tradeoffs, and a historical drift_index time series
CI job (quick smoke) completes within 12 minutes and full validation (2k) can be scheduled as a separate job
Automated PR/rollback is created when canary fails gate and human readable summary is included
